notes: Canonical authoring reference for wiki Authoring-Dialogue.md. Archetype: Coalition Broker (Ray Nguyen, NV Independent). Arc beat: Escalation — player recruits Nguyen to broker cross-party support for the infrastructure bill. Demonstrates: text-variant array with faction-standing condition, rng:pick token for opening variation, compound any-of condition (trait OR npc-relationship), isHidden option with costs, bill-stage gate, two convergent branches, update-relationship + set-flag effects. NPC line lengths at price-reveal (26 words) and broker-engage (21 words) are at the upper budget — acceptable for list-making register per §12.5.3 flavour-line allowance.

text.text: You've been working the Reform Bloc. {rng:pick:That's useful.|I noticed.|That's one room. We need three.}
{rng:pick:Who's a no on your bill? Have you asked them why?|Walk me through the holdouts. Not the votes — the reasons.|I've been watching your coalition. You're two senators short and you know it.}

options.label: Birch and Okonkwo. One's a wall, one's a door.
options.failureHint: Requires Strategy 4. You haven't mapped the chamber yet.

options.label: I can make it worth your while.
What does it take to get you in the room?

price-reveal.speaker: npc
price-reveal.text: I don't have a price. I have a list. Birch wants the harbour rider dropped. Okonkwo wants a fiscal note. Give me something to work with.

options.label: The harbour rider goes. What does the fiscal note look like?
options.failureHint: The bill has left committee. That rider cannot be stripped now.

options.label: The harbour rider stays. Find me another way.

broker-engage.speaker: npc
broker-engage.text: All right. I'll put people in the room. I'm not promising votes — I'm promising a conversation. You close it.

options.label: A conversation is all I need.

exit-cold.speaker: npc
exit-cold.text: Come back when you've got room to move. I don't broker dead ends.
